title: Physics describes only structure and dynamics

statements.text: Physics describes the world by its spatiotemporal structure and dynamics and says nothing about what underlies them. It tells what mass and charge do, how they dispose objects to move, but not what they are: its predicates express only mathematical and causal concepts.

sources.quote: physics describes the world in terms of its spatiotemporal structure and dynamics (changes within that structure) and says nothing about what, if anything, underlies that structure and dynamics
its predicates express only mathematical and causal concepts
physics says nothing about the intrinsic nature of these entities and properties
